commits.subject: perf(server): Pull no longer waits behind other repositories' fetches (6.3 s → 0.21 s median) (#30059)
commits.reason: Background status fetches now carry a queued/running/claimed state: pullCurrentBranch claims its remote's fetch while it is still queued for a permit (behind other repositories) and runs its own fetch instead of waiting up to 20 s; the claimed fetch runs afterwards only if the pull failed, was interrupted, or fetched the upstream only. A running fetch is still awaited (bounded). The pull's own status reads now skip the upstream refresh (they previously started and waited on a background fetch themselves); with no branch remote it still awaits the repository's fetches. Push is unchanged.
